# Benchmark

How long custos and other PHP tools take on real projects, and how much memory they
need. The [benchmark workflow](https://github.com/janalis/custos/actions/workflows/benchmark.yml) refreshes these
numbers every week, with the latest release of every tool and project.

::: warning Different tools, different jobs
Type checkers infer much more than custos, linters mostly check style, and fixers
rewrite code. Compare times within a kind, and read finding counts only as a sign that
a tool did its work: each counts what its own rules look for.
:::

Measured on 2026-11-09 on linux/amd64, Test CPU, 4 cores, 16 GB of memory, with PHP 8.4.1.
Each time is the median of 3 runs.

## app

[v/app](https://github.com/v/app) at `v1.0.0`, 120 PHP files.

| Tool | Kind | Version | Time | vs custos | Peak memory | Findings |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **custos analyse** | analyzer | 1.0.0 | 0.50 s | 1.0× | 80 MB | 12 |
| Mid | analyzer | 1.0.0 | 12.3 s | 25× | 300 MB | 40 |
| Slow | analyzer | 2.0.0 | 150 s | 300× | 2.0 GB | 300 |
| Broken | analyzer | 1.0.0 | error: &lt;bad&gt; \| &#123;&#123;x&#125;&#125; more | — | — | — |
| Lint | linter | 1.0.0 | 1.00 s | 2.0× | 30 MB | 7 |
| Fixer | fixer | 1.0.0 | 2.00 s | — | 50 MB | 3 |

## Method

- Every tool analyzes the project's source directories with its own configuration
  from [`bench/configs`](https://github.com/janalis/custos/tree/develop/bench/configs), after the project's
  dependencies are installed, so that analyzers can resolve vendor symbols.
- Each run starts from an empty cache, after a warm-up run that fills the
  operating system's file cache. Tools use their default parallelism, or every
  core when they have to be told.
- Peak memory sums the resident memory of the tool's processes, including its
  parallel workers.
- Findings: problems reported by analyzers and linters, edits `custos fix` would
  apply, and files other fixers would change. Fixers run in dry-run mode.
- *vs custos* divides a tool's time by the time of the custos command of the
  same kind (`custos analyse`, or `custos fix` for fixers).
- Run it yourself with `make compare`; the tools, versions and projects are listed
  in [`bench/competitors.json`](https://github.com/janalis/custos/blob/develop/bench/competitors.json).
